title: Western Alliance Bank’s Todd Popovich Named 2026 Commercial Real Estate Visionary for Innovation and Expansion
summary: Todd Popovich, Western Alliance Bank’s managing director of Institutional Commercial Real Estate Finance for California, has been named a 2026 Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Visionary by the LA Times Studios.
body_markdown:
*Recognition honors leaders shaping commercial real estate finance, capital access and market growth*


Todd Popovich, Western Alliance Bank’s managing director of Institutional Commercial Real Estate Finance for California, has been named a 2026 Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Visionary by the LA Times Studios. The honor recognizes his role in expanding access to capital across California’s institutional commercial real estate market.


Popovich joined Western Alliance Bank in September 2025 to lead its[Institutional Commercial Real Estate Group](https://www.westernalliancebancorporation.com/expertise/commercial-real-estate-and-construction) in California, a key growth market for the bank. Over the past year, his team has grown the division’s land acquisition financing, construction debt, bridge debt for adaptive reuse and office acquisition financing offerings and expanded the team to further extend the bank’s California CRE coverage.


Popovich’s recognition reflects the increasing importance of specialized financing across the real estate sector and Western Alliance Bank’s entrepreneurial approach to serving clients in more than 30 industries nationwide. His team works with institutional sponsors across all major product types and structures, providing bridge and interim financing to support acquisitions, ground-up construction, repositioning and adaptive reuse.


“Todd has spent three decades helping institutional sponsors capitalize their most complex projects,” said Tim Bruckner, Chief Banking Officer, Regional Banking, Western Alliance Bank. “This recognition is a testament to the trust our clients place in him throughout the financial process and to the team he is building in one of our most important markets.”


[Read Popovich’s full CRE Visionary profile](https://www.latimes.com/b2b/business-visionaries/commercial-real-estate/todd-popovich)


[View the full list of 2026 CRE Visionaries](https://www.latimes.com/b2b/business-visionaries/commercial-real-estate)
